product.name: HDMI eARC Audio Extender over Cat5e/6/6A up to 50m
product.description: HDMI® Audio Extender Over Cat5e/6/6A with eARC ‑ 50m RangeSeamlessly extend HDMI audio up to 50 meters (164ft) over Ethernet cable, with eARC, CEC and Bi‑directional IR controlEffortlessly Extend Premium HDMI Audio Across Your SpaceThe HDMI Audio Extender over Cat5e/6/6A is the ultimate solution for transmitting high‑quality HDMI eARC/ARC audio signals over long distances. Using a single Cat5e/6/6A Ethernet cable, this device can seamlessly send audio up to 50 meters (164 feet) without sacrificing quality, making it perfect for home theaters, AV receivers, and multi‑room audio systems. It supports a wide range of advanced audio formats, including eARC: LPCM 2.0/5.1/7.1CH, DD, DD+, DTS™, Dolby TrueHD™, DTS‑HD™ MA, and Dolby Atmos. For ARC, it handles LPCM 2.0CH, Dolby™ 5.1CH, and DTS 5.1CH, ensuring compatibility with most audio setups.The extender features CEC pass‑through and bi‑directional IR pass‑through, allowing for unified control and flexibility from either end of the connection. Its compact, plug‑and‑play design makes installation straight‑forward and unobtrusive, letting you eliminate cable clutter while maintaining superb audio fidelity.
